$comment: Token prices for cost attribution (design §18, COST_PRICE_TABLE_PATH).
Prices are integer micro-USD per 1,000 tokens. Micro-USD is used rather than cents because a
single 1k-token call costs a fraction of a cent, and the platform rule is that money is never
a float: rounding to cents happens once, at the API boundary, after aggregation.
Values below are placeholders. Update from the AWS Bedrock pricing page per region.
